pages.title: Giant Beaver
pages.text: $(o)Castoroides$() ($(o)Castoroides ohioensis$()), the giant beaver, lived in the lakes and wetlands of North America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was about the size of a black bear, with huge incisors, but it probably did not build dams or fell trees like modern beavers, feeding instead on water plants.$(br2)It vanished at the end of the last ice age.
